title: Find out if and when you need to use Making Tax Digital for Income Tax
quote: If your qualifying income is over: £50,000 for the 2024 to 2025 tax year, you should’ve started using Making Tax Digital for Income Tax from 6 April 2026 — you can still sign up or sign up your client, if you have not already done so £30,000 for the 2025 to 2026 tax year, you will need to use it from 6 April 2027 £20,000 for the 2026 to 2027 tax year, you will need to use it from 6 April 2028
